evidence.name: Preserved mesh

evidence.name: Rooted motif groups

evidence.name: Flow at roots

evidence.name: Endpoint identity
evidence.basis: Actual spine site aliases
evidence.note: A crossing-landmark attachment is incidence on a selected strand, not a new weld or a join between warp and weft.

evidence.basis: Native occupied bands, tapered side profiles and shared radial roots
